what: Instead of a fade, it switches on like a fluorescent lamp — when the element top reaches 25% below the screen center, it stands up from transparent in five beats (.2s) of .04s each: on·off·on·off·on. If there are several children (item), they go in random order .03s apart. With loop, after switching on, each child waits 0~loop seconds and then flickers off and on twice at the last 10% of a 2s beat, repeating endlessly (album name·place text buzz now and then). look: ramp — each child repeats transparent→opaque 4~5 times at .1s linear (filling up like a sawtooth) and switches on late by a random 0~.4s, and first switches on only the first child once at .8s for .2s (space vegetable site title)

options.[data-fx-part=item]: Children to switch on in turn — if none, the element itself
options.step: Length of one beat (seconds), default .04 · look: ramp is .1
options.delay: Wait before turning on (sec), default 0 — original album first card .75, the rest .25
options.loop: Maximum wait (seconds) for repeating flicker after turning on, default 0 (off) — original album name 10
options.--fx-loop-beat: One beat of the repeating blink (via style), default 2s
options.look: ramp: fills from transparent to opaque on every beat, repeating (default five on-off beats) · glitch: each piece is delayed randomly 0~spread (default .4) s, on .04 → off .08 (+.12) → on .12 (+.2) expo.out (ai-model title·items)
options.beats: look: ramp repeat count — given like 「4-5」, each child gets a random number in between, default 4-5
options.spread: look: max random delay (sec) per child of ramp, default .4
options.first: look: in ramp, only the first child is switched on once for 2 × step at this second (seconds) — original .8. If absent, the first child behaves like the others
options.on: load: turns on after delay as soon as it attaches, without waiting for scroll (first screen title after the loader — original 3) · event: turns on when fx:play is fired at the element (for when the side using the loader’s end decides)
options.shift: In look: glitch, each piece turns on by moving x or y from −shift% to its place in .04s — 50 SVG letter pieces on the original hero
